sections.title: Travel and Holidays
sections.content: Planning a trip needs the things you book and the things you pack. Note that 'las vacaciones' is always plural in Spanish, like 'the holidays' — there is no 'una vacación'. 'La ropa' goes the other way: it is always singular, so clothes are 'la ropa', never 'las ropas'.

items.spanish: Kaylee quiere alquilar unas bicicletas para recorrer la zona.
items.english: Kaylee wants to hire bikes to get around the area.

items.spanish: Buscan información sobre hoteles y trenes.
items.english: They look for information about hotels and trains.

items.spanish: También hablan del tiempo y de la ropa que van a llevar.
items.english: They also talk about the weather and the clothes they'll take.

items.spanish: Ya falta muy poco para empezar las vacaciones.
items.english: It's not long now until the holidays start.

sections.content: 'Llevar' is take in the sense of carrying something with you — 'llevo mi cámara'. To take a train you use 'tomar' or simply 'ir en tren'.
